title: What Caused the Humiliation of the Muslim World
body:
Dastoor ya, Sayyidee, madad. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah.
O our Lord! Give to your most beloved one, Your deputy from pre-Eternal up to Eternal, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! Zidhu yaa Rabbee, zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran wa surooran, Grant to him
from Your endless Glory Oceans, grant to him from Your endless Majestic Oceans, grant to him all praisings
that You are not granting to anyone else. O our Lord, forgive us! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As-salaamu `alaykum, our attenders from human s as well from jinns, because they are attending. And we
can’t count their numbers. If we are seven billion, they may be 70 billion. All of them are trying to be honored
by being servants. There are so many also from jinns that are following Shaytan and its followers, but Allah
Almighty is saying, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) asta`idhubillah:
•••••• •••• •••••••• •••••••• •••••••••• ••••• •••••••••• ••••• ••••••••
qul jaa al-haqq wa zahaqq al-baatil inna al-baatila kaana zahooqa, Verily Truth has come and falsehood has

perished; truly falsehood is bound to perish!” (al-Isra 17:81)
Yes, finished! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Shaytan and its armies, its supporters, and followers may be billions, trillions or quadrillions, but they cannot
do anything! They think they can do something and they are trying to cheat the foolish masses of Mankind.
And now from east to west, from north to south people are drunk, and drunken ones never understand
anything.
O Salafi `ulamas! As-salaamu `alaykum also. You must be at peace with me. I am a weakest servant. You
must support me. Say, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Say! A’oodhu billahi min nafsee alkhabeetha, “I seek refuge in Allah from my filthy ego.” Man is always asking to be with his egoistic being.
Why are you not saying to people, "You are not only going to be of human nature with your ego, no.”
Say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Grant
us, O our responsible one. I am ashamed to call the Lord of Creation, so I am asking from the responsible one
for this world a support. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) I am ashamed to address to anyone else, only he who has
responsibility for human beings on this planet. It is enough, more than enough!
You must make it clear to those groups of people claiming, "We are Salafi `ulamas." Why are you not making
an understanding for our beings in this life? Open it, so that people may understand their personality or their
identity, yes. Why are you not making it clear? That is a big wrong doing from you. The first lesson that you
must teach Mankind is what are their responsibilities. Are you saying this? You must say what our
responsibility is in this life. I never heard one of you speak on that point, what is the most important reality to
be known and also to be followed. Why are you not making this clear? You have as much as you are asking
from material support; you have so much!
Why are you not broadcasting? Why? To reach from east and to west, from north to south, black ones, white
ones, yellow ones, red ones, and there may be green ones! (laughter) No sir, human beings never heard of
such a tribe. May be, if there are green ones must be blue ones also! You may reach to everyone bi
imkaanikum, you may reach to every point on this planet where you will find humanity. Why are you not
declaring to them about their identities? Insaan, human, the real position of humanity! And who may tell

about real humanity to common people, except those who are claiming, "We know everything!” Say!
Where is that center of broadcasting in Saudi Arabia or its neighbors, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and the
Emirates? You have tons of money and gold. For what are you keeping it? Allah Almighty is ordering His
most beloved one, the holy command, "O My most beloved one! Balligh, declare! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Balligh!” That is a holy command. “What I am sending to you is balligh to `ibaadee, a declaration to my
people!” It is a holy command. Are you not Arabs? Where is your understanding?
••••••• ••• ••••••• •••••••• ••• ••••••••
Balligh ma unzila ilayk! Proclaim the (message) which hath been sent to you (O Muhammad) from your Lord.
(Al-Ma'idah 5:67)
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.) You are understanding, but you are not doing. Balligh, O Salafi `ulamas! What are
you making out from that declaration? Day and night, throughout east and west, countless broadcasting
stations are occupying the skies to reach people with shaytanic tabligh, message. The whole world now is
under the hegemony of Shaytan and its followers and its believers! The whole sky has hundreds or thousands
of centers of tabligh, broadcasting. Is it true or not? Throughout east and west, north to south, they are
putting hundreds of broadcasting centers in the skies to make shaytanic declarations. What are Muslims
doing? I am asking. I am asking!
This is a very weak broadcast and I am the weakest servant. What can I do? That is what I can do (this daily
live broadcast)! This is a very, very small one but shaytanic broadcasting is reaching everywhere that the Seal
of Prophets (s) was saying that there will be, (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) fitan fi aakhir al zamaan la yabqa
baytan la yadkhul fihil fitna. “There will come a time when no house will be free from fitna, worldly
temptations.” Is it true or not? Why are you not objecting on them? Why are you not bombarding on them?
That is the word of that one, who was speaking on behalf of the Lord of Heavens! (Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
••••• ••••••• •••• •••••••• •••• •••• •••••• •••••• ••••••
Wa maa yantiqu `ani ’l-hawaa in huwa illa wahyyun yooha, That [which he conveys to you] is but [a divine]
inspiration with which he is being inspired. (53:3-4)
“He doesn't open his mouth to say anything that is not revealed to him from Allah (swt).” (Mawlana Shaykh

sits.)
You are saying, "We are `alim, doctors of Shari`ah," and I am nothing here, but there are appearing in my
heart's mirror some words that are helping me to combine. But if Shakespeare is hearing some verse he will
be ashamed, "I never heard such English!" (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.) Yes, I am nothing, and trying to reach
the centers of baatil, falsehood and shaytanic powers! I am trying to bombard them. Alhamdulillah, this
bombarding is never going wrong! And you, who have every ability to bombard Shaytan’s broadcasting
towers, why are you not doing that? I heard that they are sending a virus to destroy one center; they are
saying this. Why are you not sending a virus to all those shaytanic centers? Why? Is there no money with
you? You have money, but perhaps no mind!
If you have some mind, then that is the fruit of our mental faculties Allah has granted us. You can do that, but
you are not doing. And will be, ashaddul-`adhaab ala al-`ulama yawm al-qiyaamah, alladheena hum kaan,
yahkoon kalaam wa laa yasta`milooon imkaan takhreeban li ’l-baatil (the heaviest punishment will be on the
Islamic scholars on the Day of Resurrection, those who used to speak many [empty] words but they did not
use their abilities to destroy falsehood).
O Scholars! Your real mission is takhreebu ’l-baatil, “To destroy all that is false,” to destroy izhaaqqu ’l-baatil,
to destroy away. Why are you not using that power? And you are always accusing our simple people who are
trying to do something for Allah Almighty, their Creator and their most beloved Prophet (s). You attack them,
saying, “You are making bida`, shirk, baatil kufr, you are falling in haraam.” Leave those people alone. who
are asking Allah Almighty's rida, pleasure?!And wa li kull imri in maa nawa, “Everyone gets what they
intend.”
•••• ••••••• •••••••
Innamaa ’l-`amaal bin-niyyaat, You are rewarded for your deeds according to your intention. (Muslim)
You know them. Don't accuse simple people and don’t try to prevent them from what they are doing! They
are doing it for li ridaa ar-Rabb, for the pleasure of their Lord, Allah Almighty! Why are you always assaulting
simple people, and so many Shaytan’s agents are preventing not to give salaat wa ’s-salaam after adhaan? Or
so many foolish ones who are slaves of Shaytan are preventing not to be recited between fard and sunnah,
Qul Hu Allahu Ahad. What is that foolishness? They are first class foolish ones in Turkey and in Cyprus!

For what is this, to say as-salaatu wa ’s-salaamu `alayk is tafhkeer, to make shari`atullah down? If you are
making as-salaatu was-salaamu `alayk yaa Rasul Allah, that is honor! And also Ikhlaas Sharif. Why are they
preventing this? Shaytan says, “Don't say,” and they are preventing. In Turkey, in Cyprus and in so many
countries of Islam, they are fighting aboout nothing except, as-salaatu was-salaam and Ikhlaas Shareef! What
is that foolishness? And there is such a big field for you to make bombarding and assaulting on Shaytan!
Bombard them! Why are you blaming Muslims if they are saying, “As-salaatu was-salaamu `alayk,” or if
saying, “Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, Qul Hu Allahu Ahad.” What is bida`? Why are you preventing?
Something will come and bombard on your heads and doctors won’t be able to find any treatment for you! All
awliyaa are very angry with them, very angry!
O People! Show an unlimited field for working against or for fighting Shaytan. You are leaving that and
running after such things. Is that from Islam? Allahu Akbar `alayhim. Allahu Akbar `alayhim. Allahu Akbar
`alayhim.
O Salafi `ulamas! What are you doing? I don’t think that it is acceptable in Heavens or with awliyas or with
Prophet’s (s) people, Prophet’s (s) jama`at, group. I don’t think Allah Almighty is going to be happy when
people say, “Don’t recite, ‘Qul Hu Allahu Ahad.’” What is that foolishness? O Turkish People! Turkey is the
highest Islamic state; then why are you making this? Perhaps there may come on you a heavenly punishment
that will never leave you until you are dying. Beware of heavenly anger! May Allah forgive us.
O People! We must try to fight Shaytan and shaytanic groups. May Allah forgive us and send us a sultan,
because ummat al-Habeeb, the whole nation of the Seal of Prophets (s) is leaving the most important order or
heavenly command, "O Muslims! You must have one on your state, Ameer al-Mu`mineen.’” Everywhere that
there is khalifatullah, must be Imam al-Muslimeen. Without that one, you will always be going down and
down, and Shaytan's groups will be taking you as adhillah, humiliated.
Allah, yaa Rabbee! We are asking forgiveness, and looking from Your servants for someone to open the
understanding of Your servants, so that we can understand what is the importance of having a sultan over the
whole ummah. All nations are fearing from China, saying they have billions of people. It is not important!
What is important is that they must be under one person’s command; one person to be commander over

billions of people. Therefore, all the nations are fearing them. We have been ordered to have one person over
all Muslims. We left it and we are adhillah (humiliated)! The Muslim world is now falling down, falling to the
shoes of kufr. May Allah forgive us. O People!
Tawbah yaa Rabbee. Tawbah yaa Rabbee. Tawbah yaa astaghfirullah. If making such a speech is wrong
against shari`atullah, then heavenly intiqaam, revenge may come on me! If you are on the wrong way, you
must fear, O doctors of Shari`ah, doctors of Azhar ash-Shareef, doctors of Salaf us-Saalih. You must fear that
at one unexpected time, a heavenly revenge may touch you. Lightening may come on your head, and then you
will be as a coal (burnt). Beware of heavenly revenge. Astaghfirullah. Tawbah yaa Rabbee. Astaghfirullah.
Fatihah.
La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits.)
Fatihah.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two rakaat Salat ash-Shukr.)
